units.source_text: 古歌：“身既不足数，不要相思苦。

en.t: An old poem says: Since I am already too insignificant to count, I should not suffer the pain of longing.

units.source_text: 岂知亦犹人，沾袖泪如雨。”

en.t: Yet who would have known that I too am like other people, with tears soaking my sleeves like rain.
This appears in the Later Collection of Japanese Poems.
